CollectDigitsToolParameters.title: CollectDigitsToolParameters
CollectDigitsToolParameters.description:
Collects digits from the caller via DTMF keypad and/or spoken digit sequences.

WHEN TO USE: National ID / Iqama, phone numbers, OTP codes, account numbers—any numeric capture
where keypad input reduces recognition errors versus free-form transcription.

Two length modes, mutually exclusive:
- Fixed: `num_digits` set — capture exactly that many digits (IDs, fixed OTPs).
- Variable: `num_digits` unset — capture until the stop key, `max_digits`, or an
  inter-digit pause once at least `min_digits` arrived (amounts, order numbers).

DataExtractionEnabled.title: DataExtractionEnabled
DataExtractionEnabled.description:
Captures structured data from conversations for analytics and business intelligence.

WHEN TO USE:
- Client needs specific data points extracted from calls
- Business requires analytics on conversation outcomes
- Data needs to be stored in structured format for CRM/reporting systems

HOW TO CONFIGURE:
1. Define the JSON schema with clear property names
2. Specify data types: boolean, string, number, or enum (for multiple choice)
3. Add descriptive titles and descriptions for each field
4. Mark required fields - only fields critical for business value
5. Use enum for predefined options (e.g., contact methods, categories)

COMMON USE CASES:
- E-commerce: Discount acceptance, preferred contact method, product feedback
- Healthcare: Symptom severity, appointment preferences, satisfaction ratings
- Banking: Transaction types, complaint categories, resolution preferences
- Customer Service: Issue type, urgency level, satisfaction score
- Sales: Lead quality, interest level, budget range, decision timeframe

NOTE: Only include data extraction when the client needs structured data
capture. Not all scenarios require this feature.

IntegrationProvider.title: IntegrationProvider
IntegrationProvider.description:
Available integration providers.

`salla-tools` and `zoho-desk-create-ticket` require external OAuth setup and are
NEVER auto-generated in the output tool config, connected or not - suggest them
instead (see `Suggestion Categorization for Integration Tools` below).

**Suggestion Categorization for Integration Tools:**

   **Use `verification_needed`** (shows in "Action Required" section):
   - When user EXPLICITLY mentions needing Salla/Zoho in their business requirements
   - Example: User says "We use Salla for orders" but Salla not in active integrations
   - This is a REQUIREMENT the user stated - they need to set it up

   **Use `resource_linking`** (shows in "Opportunities" section):
   - When LLM SUGGESTS an integration that could enhance the scenario
   - User did NOT ask for this; LLM thinks it would be helpful
   - Example: For a restaurant scenario, LLM suggests Salla could help with order tracking

**Examples:**

User prompt: "We need Salla for order management"
Active integrations: None connected
→ DO NOT add a salla-tools entry to the tool config
→ ADD `verification_needed` suggestion: "Connect Salla Store" with action_url="/integrations"

User prompt: "Restaurant delivery agent" (no mention of Salla/Zoho)
Active integrations: zoho
→ DO NOT add a zoho-desk-create-ticket entry to the tool config
→ Can suggest salla as `resource_linking` (optional enhancement)

SuccessCriterion.title: SuccessCriterion
SuccessCriterion.description:
Defines a success criterion for evaluating call outcomes.

Success criteria determine whether a call achieved its business objectives.
They are used for analytics and quality monitoring.

- Could be tool-related: "Agent transferred to specialist when customer requested human advisor"
- Could be business-related: "Offered loyalty program benefits to retain customer"

STRUCTURE:
- PRIMARY (is_primary=True): Exactly ONE criterion that determines call success/failure.
  The text field can contain multiple points separated by newlines.
  Format: "- Point 1\n- Point 2\n- Point 3"
    - Single point: "Successfully collected customer feedback and confirmed satisfaction"
    - Multiple points: "- Collected customer payment information\\n- Confirmed scheduled payment date\\n- Sent payment confirmation"
    - With tool call: "- Collected issue details\\n- Created support ticket\\n- Confirmed ticket number"
  ALL points must be met for the call to be marked as successful.

- SECONDARY (is_primary=False): Zero or more additional criteria.
  Each secondary is a separate object. These are nice-to-have objectives
  that don't affect overall call success/failure status.

TOOL CALLS IN SUCCESS CRITERIA:
- As Primary: When tool call IS the main business objective
  Example: "Agent successfully created support ticket with all required fields"
- As Secondary: When tool usage is optional/supplementary
  Example: "Agent transferred to specialist when loan exceeded $100K"
- Not in Criteria: When it's standard operation (e.g., end-call is expected behavior)

CRITICAL DISTINCTION:
- Tool CONFIGURATION (messages, conditions) → Define in "tools" array
- Tool USAGE EVALUATION → Define here ONLY when it's a business objective

TransferToHumanToolParameters.title: TransferToHumanToolParameters
TransferToHumanToolParameters.description:
Transfers the call to a human agent when the AI cannot handle the situation.

WHEN TO USE: When users need human assistance for complex issues, complaints,
or situations the AI is not equipped to handle.
BEST PRACTICES:
- Define 3-5 specific transfer scenarios
- Include both customer-initiated (requests human) and agent-initiated (complex issue) cases
- Use reassuring transfer messages
- Configure DTMF trigger (usually "*") for instant human access
- Set appropriate working hours if the transfer destination has limited availability

VoicemailDetectionToolParameters.title: VoicemailDetectionToolParameters
VoicemailDetectionToolParameters.description:
Detects when the call has reached a voicemail or answering machine and responds appropriately.

WHEN TO USE: Include in outbound call scenarios where the agent may reach voicemail.
BEST PRACTICES:
- Set hangup_when_voicemail_detected to true to end the call immediately on detection
- Use message_before_hangup with a MultiLingualMessage for a fixed recorded message
- Use message_before_hangup with an LLMInstruction to let the agent generate the message
